resources.string: Animated lectures with voice for Sindh Computer Science XI and XII
Vocals use your phone\'s text-to-speech voice. For the clearest English voice, install Google Text-to-speech and download English voice data.
Voice data missing. The script stays on screen.

Each board is drawn while a voice reads the script. The voice is the Android text-to-speech engine on this phone. If you hear nothing, open system settings, search for Text-to-speech, install a voice, and download English.
Original whiteboard lessons for the Sindh Computer Science XI and XII syllabus. Scripts are written for this app and spoken with your device voice. Version %1$s.
Pick a class to start a lecture.
